metadata.title: OMEGA Unified Country General Data Registry
metadata.description: Canonical common-schema registry aggregating identity, basic facts, economy, demographics, general indexes, resource context and public-safety summary for every identity in countries.json.

externalRefresh.policy: A refreshed observation replaces a legacy value only when the World Bank API returns a numeric observation. When a refresh is unavailable, previously stored World Bank observations are preserved.

dataQualityPolicy.nullMeans: unknown, unavailable, not imported, or not comparable; never zero
dataQualityPolicy.countryScope: all country and territory identities in countries.json, not only UN member states
dataQualityPolicy.mergePolicy: additive aggregation with per-field provenance; original source datasets remain untouched
dataQualityPolicy.crossMetricComparisons: different indicators can have different observation years; check metricMetadata[field].year before combining
dataQualityPolicy.disciplineIndex: left null unless a defined, comparable source or an approved project-specific formula exists

recordSchema.description: Each group array follows its listed field names in order. Metric positions follow fieldCatalogue. Provenance integer codes decode with metadata.provenanceEncoding. All source observations are retained; null is never zero.

sourceNames: Derived from same-year World Bank observations

sharedModelNotes.crimeSourcePolicy: Only observedHomicide is marked source-observed in this local baseline. Other crime rates are modeled simulation values unless their source says otherwise.
sharedModelNotes.resourceEmptyLists: An empty array means no entries were recorded in this source record; it does not prove the country has no such resource.
